## 2024-2026: LFP Scale and Lithium-Ion Optimization

Expected dominant changes:

- Continued LFP expansion in cost-sensitive EVs.
- Continued NMC/NCA use in long-range and premium vehicles.
- Gradual silicon-anode content increases inside lithium-ion cells.
- Early sodium-ion products in limited or China-led use cases.
- Semi-solid and quasi-solid demonstration fleets or limited-volume products.

Proof gates:

- Pack-level cost and degradation data.
- Cold-weather sodium-ion validation.
- Silicon-anode cycle-life validation at automotive scale.
- Semi-solid pack cost and safety data.

## 2027-2028: Bridge Chemistries and First Solid-State Launches

Expected dominant changes:

- GM/LG LMR pre-production and planned commercial production for large EVs.
- Toyota-targeted all-solid-state BEV launch window.
- More OEM validation of semi-solid and all-solid-state cells.
- More dual-chemistry pack experiments.

Proof gates:

- Real vehicle deployments, not only cell announcements.
- Warranty terms and degradation curves.
- Production yield and pack cost.
- Safety validation under standardized automotive conditions.

## 2029-2035: Scale or Narrowing

Expected dominant changes:

- LFP/LMFP may dominate mainstream affordable EVs.
- High-nickel and LMR may compete for large, long-range, and premium EVs.
- Solid-state may scale if cost, yield, and life targets are met.
- Lithium-sulfur may enter specialty or automotive validation toward 2030 if Stellantis/Zeta and Lyten programs succeed.

Proof gates:

- High-volume production outside China.
- Price parity with mature lithium-ion at pack level.
- Verified lifetime and replacement economics.
- Used-market valuation by chemistry and model segment.

## Roadmap Interpretation

The most likely near-term disruption is not a single leap to solid-state. It is a sequence of incremental improvements: cheaper LFP, higher-density phosphate and manganese-rich cathodes, better silicon anodes, and selective semi-solid deployments. All-solid-state and lithium-sulfur matter more as late-2020s or early-2030s options unless production data changes.
